gameoverse_controller_plus.title: Gameoverse Controller Plus
gameoverse_controller_plus.binding.open_: Opens the hold, multi-tap and layer bind settings.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.title: Gameoverse Controller Plus
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.intro: Adds hold, multi-tap and button-combination binds on top of Controlify. They only work in game, with no screen open. A button only waits to decide what you meant if it has one of these binds.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.enable: Turns every advanced bind on or off.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.rumble: A short rumble when a hold or multi-tap bind fires.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.modifi: A layer button (LB, RB) released within this time, without pressing a button of its layer, still does its normal action. Held longer, it does nothing.
Replaces your bind list with the default layout. Save to keep it. With the default layout you also get future changes to it.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.binds_: Each bind: a trigger, the action it runs and how. Settings a trigger type doesn't use are ignored.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.add.de: Adds a new bind at the end of the list.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.t: Tap: a short press. Hold: held for a time. Multi-tap: pressed several times quickly. Layer: pressed while the modifier button is held. Chord: both buttons held together, either order. Scoped: pressed while looking through a spyglass or zoom, repeating while held; the button does nothing else while scoped.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.b: The button. For a layer, the button pressed while the modifier is held. For a chord, the first of the two.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.m: Layer: the button held first. Chord: the second button. Other triggers ignore it.
Hold: how long to hold before the action runs. A shorter press does the button's tap action. Scoped: how long to hold before the action starts repeating.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.w: Multi-tap: the longest gap between presses. A single tap on this button waits this long before it runs. Scoped: the time between repeats.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.a: Any Controlify binding id (controlify:..., or controlify_modded:<key name> for another mod's key), gameoverse_controller_plus:spell_slot_N for the N-th spell on your spell bar that isn't on the use trigger, or gameoverse_controller_plus:scroll_up / scroll_down for one mouse wheel step.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.m: Press: a short press. Hold While: held down for as long as the trigger button stays held (charged spells, zoom). Toggle: each trigger switches it between held and released.
